title: The pup at ten, the ramp, slowly
logline: The pup going up Gully's ramp at ten, slowly, from the side, one plank at a time, Gully's boots waiting at the top. The ramp doing what it was built for.

panels.composition: A small three-legged dog going slowly up a plank ramp from the side, one plank at a time, a stocky man's work boots waiting at the top.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small three-legged dog climbing a plank ramp slowly seen from the side with a stocky man's work boots waiting at the top, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
